import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/titanic.csv')

# Create a figure with subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 10))
fig.suptitle('Titanic Passenger Survival Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.00)

# 1. Survival rate by class and sex
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
survival_data = df.groupby(['class', 'sex'])['survived'].mean().unstack()
survival_data.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax1, color=['#FF6B9D', '#4A90E2'], alpha=0.8)
ax1.set_title('Survival Rate by Class and Sex', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_xlabel('Passenger Class', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_ylabel('Survival Rate', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_xticklabels(ax1.get_xticklabels(), rotation=45, ha='right')
ax1.legend(title='Sex', loc='upper right')
ax1.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')
ax1.set_ylim(0, 1)

# 2. Age distribution by survival
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
survived_ages = df[df['survived'] == 1]['age'].dropna()
died_ages = df[df['survived'] == 0]['age'].dropna()
ax2.hist([died_ages, survived_ages], bins=20, label=['Died', 'Survived'], 
         color=['#E74C3C', '#2ECC71'], alpha=0.7, edgecolor='black')
ax2.set_title('Age Distribution by Survival Status', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_xlabel('Age (years)', fontsize=10)
ax2.set_ylabel('Number of Passengers', fontsize=10)
ax2.legend(loc='upper right')
ax2.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

# 3. Fare distribution by class and survival
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
for pclass in sorted(df['pclass'].unique()):
    class_data = df[df['pclass'] == pclass]
    survived_fare = class_data[class_data['survived'] == 1]['fare']
    died_fare = class_data[class_data['survived'] == 0]['fare']
    
sns.violinplot(data=df, x='class', y='fare', hue='survived', split=True, 
               palette={0: '#E74C3C', 1: '#2ECC71'}, ax=ax3, inner='quartile')
ax3.set_title('Fare Distribution by Class and Survival', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_xlabel('Passenger Class', fontsize=10)
ax3.set_ylabel('Fare (£)', fontsize=10)
ax3.set_ylim(0, 300)
handles, labels = ax3.get_legend_handles_labels()
ax3.legend(handles, ['Died', 'Survived'], title='Survival', loc='upper right')
ax3.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

# 4. Overall survival statistics
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
survival_stats = []
categories = []

# Overall survival
categories.append('Overall')
survival_stats.append(df['survived'].mean())

# By sex
for sex in ['male', 'female']:
    categories.append(f'{sex.capitalize()}')
    survival_stats.append(df[df['sex'] == sex]['survived'].mean())

# By class
for pclass in sorted(df['pclass'].unique()):
    categories.append(f'Class {pclass}')
    survival_stats.append(df[df['pclass'] == pclass]['survived'].mean())

colors = ['#9B59B6', '#FF6B9D', '#4A90E2', '#F39C12', '#16A085', '#E67E22']
bars = ax4.barh(categories, survival_stats, color=colors, alpha=0.8, edgecolor='black')
ax4.set_title('Survival Rates Across Categories', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_xlabel('Survival Rate', fontsize=10)
ax4.set_ylabel('Category', fontsize=10)
ax4.set_xlim(0, 1)
ax4.grid(axis='x', alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

# Add percentage labels on bars
for i, (bar, val) in enumerate(zip(bars, survival_stats)):
    ax4.text(val + 0.02, i, f'{val:.1%}', va='center', fontsize=9)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
